Choose the calculation by the quantity you need. Each row is a workflow
SCGSim prepares and reads back; the solvers can do more than SCGSim
implements.

::: {.table-responsive}

| Calculation | Solver | You give | You get | Guide |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Capacitance | Palace Electrostatic | A `GeometryPlan`, terminal and ground Nets | The capacitance matrix, in terminal order | [Capacitance with Palace](../guides/capacitance-palace.qmd) |
| Resonant modes | Palace Eigenmode | A `GeometryPlan`, optional inductive ports | Mode frequency and Q, energies; EPR when requested | [Modes with Palace](../guides/modes-palace.qmd) |
| Resonant modes | HFSS Eigenmode | A `GeometryPlan`, `modeling` | Mode frequency and Q; EPR when requested | [Modes with HFSS](../guides/modes-hfss.qmd) |
| S-parameters | HFSS Driven Terminal | A `GeometryPlan` with two lumped Terminal port sheets, `modeling` | Complex S-parameters, CSV and Touchstone | [S-parameters with HFSS](../guides/s-parameters-hfss.qmd) |
| Capacitance and conductance | Q3D | A `GeometryPlan`, `modeling` | The C/G matrix | [Capacitance with Q3D](../guides/capacitance-q3d.qmd) |
| Line parameters | Q2D | Rectangles of the cross-section and their conductor groups | Per-unit-length C, G, L and R | [Line parameters with Q2D](../guides/line-parameters-q2d.qmd) |

:::

[]{#source-and-result-differences}Every 3D calculation solves the same model: SCGSim's geometry builder, SGB,
builds it from the plan, Palace meshes it, and HFSS and Q3D import it as a
STEP file. Shared geometry does not make the results interchangeable: each
keeps its own boundaries, units and conductor, port or mode order.

## Requirements {#requirements}

- []{#palace-executable-capabilities}**Palace:** stock Palace 0.18.1 is enough, Surface EPR included. Palace
  takes [Route A or Route B](../concepts/routes.qmd) (`set_route`).
- **AEDT:** an explicit `aedt_version`, `"2023.2"` or `"2024.2"`, both through
  PyAEDT 1.3.0, with the AEDT Desktop on the same host as SCGSim; and an
  explicit `modeling="solid"` or `"thin_film"` for every HFSS and Q3D request
  ([AEDT: solid or thin_film](specs/aedt-runtime.qmd#aedt-solid-thin-film)).
- **Curves:** straight edges and circular arcs are built exactly; a spline
  must be drawn as a polygon ([Source curves](specs/geometry-plan.qmd#source-curves)).
- []{#energy-participation-and-loss}**Surface EPR** is declared once on the plan, `plan.set_surface_epr(specs)`.
  Palace Eigenmode and Electrostatic and HFSS Eigenmode read it and cut its
  margins as bands; HFSS Driven Terminal and Q3D do not. Both Palace and
  HFSS integrate every row of a declared type over all its faces, side walls
  included, unless the spec's `face_kinds` leaves them out.
  [Surface EPR](../concepts/surface-epr.qmd) explains what is computed.
- **HFSS EPR on another host:** an HFSS EPR study can be solved by AEDT's batch
  solver on a host without a Desktop ([how](specs/aedt-runtime.qmd#prepared-native-hfss-epr-batch)).

## Not available {#not-available}

- HFSS Driven Modal and Driven Terminal wave ports: a request with one is
  refused. Tracked in [issue #135](https://github.com/NCUPHY-LTLab/scgsim/issues/135).
- Q3D AC/RL: Q3D extracts C and G only. Tracked in
  [issue #265](https://github.com/NCUPHY-LTLab/scgsim/issues/265).
- Palace Driven and Magnetostatic.
- Spline curves read as curves.

Palace's [problem types](https://awslabs.github.io/palace/stable/guide/problem/)
and the [PyAEDT user guide](https://aedt.docs.pyansys.com/version/stable/User_guide/index.html)
describe what the solvers themselves offer.
